paragraphs.text: Worzel was one of the first named Planeswalkers in Magic's story. She was Thomil 's rival and a human . She was first mentioned in the eponymous short story Worzel's Story in the Alpha rulebook and was featured in Roreca's Tale in the original Magic: The Gathering Pocket Player's Guide . Both were written by Magic: The Gathering 's creator Richard Garfield , were considered the first Magic stories, and represented games of Magic: The Gathering that were one-versus-one games in the Constructed format.

Worzel was a planeswalker who dueled Thomil often, including at least once on the plane of Ergamon . Worzel traveled with her companion Roreca , who helped her locate leylines . Her form of magic manifests as physically weaving leylines into braids and casting spells from them. As the Hurloon minotaur Eumenes was summoned by a rival of Thomil, it is possible that Worzel was the minotaur's master.

She was proficient in green , blue , and red magic, and she learned to master white magic. She disdained black mana and considered its use to be "fighting dirty", hence her aversion to Thomil's methods.

After being defeated by Thomil's employment of aggressive red magic and dragons in a previous duel, Worzel sought out an expert in white magic to teach her protective spells. She offered this wizard the Glasses of Urza as payment, but the mage remained unwilling to teach her. She coerced this wizard into instructing her by defeating him in a duel, though she allowed him to keep the artifact afterward.

Later, on an unknown plane, she was challenged again by Thomil. She was now equipped with the knowledge of white magic, but she struggled to connect to the mana of the plains . She used green magic to summon minions to stall. She also contemplated her reluctance to invest in blue magic in this duel, given rumors that Thomil was summoning sea serpents that would take advantage of the mana. To Worzel's surprise, Thomil embraced using black magic and summoned zombies . Ruminating on the black magic Thomil learned, she readied her own newly-learned white magic. The outcome of the battle is unknown.

Sometime after her previous duel with Thomil, Worzel befriended her companion Roreca , who spectated several duels she partook in and aided her in finding leylines. She was still trying to master white magic, given that her healing magic was inadequate according to Roreca.

Worzel visited Cabralin before planeswalking to the plane of Ergamon , where she arrived in the Truga Jungle to seek leylines . Worzel's wards alerted her to the presence of Thomil, and she located him by conjuring a map of the area in her hand. She began braiding leylines. Worzel harnessed green leylines to summon Scryb Sprites and Grizzly Bears , preemptively held onto a blue leyline, and used a red leyline to evoke lightning bolts against Thomil. Thomil retaliated with black magic to terrify one of her bears to death and summon more zombies. Again struggling to find a white leyline, Worzel searched for one from Cabralin Shire. To stall and control the situation, Worzel used her withheld blue leyline to create a storm that unsummoned all of the creatures on the battlefield.

In the aftermath, Worzel still struggled to find a white leyline and even worse, Thomil summoned a Lord of the Pit and a "man-thing" as a sacrifice to the demon. Worzel dispatched more sprites as defense, but they were easily eliminated by the demon. The Lord of the Pit mercilessly ate the man-thing, and the demon began attacking Worzel with its fists. Roreca pondered which one of them would be eaten first. However, after recuperating, Worzel simply laughed and smiled. Finally, with a white leyline, Worzel cast a Circle of Protection: Black and withstood the demon's attacks with her now mastered white magic.

Eventually, the Lord of the Pit turned its rage to Thomil. He fled the plane, and his summoned demon vanished after raging around the plane for a time. Worzel traveled to Thomil's last location to take any lines he left in his retreat, but she could not find any. Still, she remained elated from the victory and planeswalked back to Cabralin with Roreca.
